equation_parameter_findings.finding: The bounds use alpha and the text states alpha > 0 is constant; no numeric alpha was found in the inspected paper pages.
equation_parameter_findings.offline_implementation: config/step5c_tase_offline_baseline_truth.json records alpha_escape_velocity_gain_s_inv=1.0 only as an offline hypothesis; it is not live-authorized.

equation_parameter_findings.finding: The paper gives r in [0,1] and discusses the r sweep; r=0.2 is identified for the simulation/fast convergence example, not as a separately verified production setting.
equation_parameter_findings.offline_implementation: The offline solver uses r=0.2 with explicit hypothesis opt-in; full Eq.23 acceptance is not claimed.

equation_parameter_findings.finding: The experimental safety bounds list joint velocity +/-0.15 rad/s.
equation_parameter_findings.offline_implementation: The matched offline comparison uses +/-0.15 rad/s. UR10e live limits and bounds construction remain a separate platform adaptation and are not changed by this artifact.

equation_parameter_findings.finding: Eq.17 defines T as robot-controller communication delay; Remark 6 describes introducing delay for orientation/force-sensor noise handling, but no numeric T was found.
equation_parameter_findings.offline_implementation: The provider passes explicit delay_T_s=0.004 as a prescribed offline hypothesis. A legacy None fallback still equals dt_s, but diagnostics label it implicit_dt_discretization_fallback_unverified; it is never reported as paper T=dt.

equation_parameter_findings.finding: The paper gives the continuous-time RNN equations and finite-time Lyapunov proof, but the inspected source does not prove this explicit-Euler UR10e 6-DOF implementation for nonzero commands, changing J, and finite bounds.
equation_parameter_findings.offline_implementation: The provider regression measures bounded synthetic prescribed-input behavior only; it is not a theorem or physical-contact claim.

equation_parameter_findings.finding: The paper simulation/experiment discussion states no force-sensor filter was added; paper force-ladder parameters are not a complete UR10e qualification recipe.
equation_parameter_findings.offline_implementation: The shared outer-loop test supplies prescribed force and reaction-normal vectors; it is synthetic and does not authorize replacing the existing live safety/filter path.

equation_parameter_findings.finding: The paper simulation uses a 7-DOF setup; this work compares 6x6 UR10e Jacobian inputs.
equation_parameter_findings.offline_implementation: Both offline baselines consume the same 6x6 J and identical bounds; this is not labeled a paper-faithful 7-DOF reproduction.

locally_verified_code.limitation: This verifies only the primitive, not full Eq.23 convergence or the outer loop.
The paper's continuous-time notation is discretized with stateful Euler updates; no full original-TASE acceptance is claimed.
The tested force, normal, orientation, and J traces are prescribed synthetic inputs, not closed-loop/contact data.

full_chain_input.result: Exact historical CSV was not found in the known checkout evidence roots/manifests; no synthetic CSV was created and this fixture absence does not block the independent offline implementation.
